correctness.rationale: Crown extension profiles are ideals/filters with complete strict separation, giving 4n mixed cases in exactly 3 orbits and 2B_n-1 one-sided orbits. Antichain/ideal bijection converts action to independent subsets of C_{2n}; rotations fold to 2 gcd(n,k) cyclic sites, reflections fold to a path with n+1 sites, giving Lucas and Fibonacci fixed counts. Burnside proves Q_n uniformly. Direct enumeration through n=10 and full ternary profile orbits through n=6 confirms boundary counts. Nontrivial stabilizer fraction bounded by a union over the 2n-1 nonidentity group elements.

value.rationale: The exact finite-base isomorphism invariant is motivated by forgetting parameter labels when counting pointed extensions in a homogeneous model. The formula gives a full all-n symmetry quotient, identifies the exact 3 mixed extension classes, determines an unobvious uniform reflection fixed-point law and the first one-sided asymmetric crown, and quantifies asymptotic almost-free action. These go beyond ordinary Lucas ideal counts or a routine numerical table; potential previously known independent-set bracelet formula is a residual risk.
